visualCharacteristics.structure: light full-width bar with a horizontally scrolling row of small text links; current page underlined in red; scroll arrows on overflow

contentPattern: 1 row, 1 richtext cell: <ul> of links (first link is the section home); current item derived from window.location.pathname
reuseGuidance: Use on mini-site pages (Greenpoint, System updates hub, Global Outlook, Investing in people, Advancing climate solutions, Worldwide giving report) directly below hero-article-banner and above columns-article-header. Not for the global header or in-page anchor lists.
